emails.body:
Hi Mark,

I just had a call with a WHOOP's CSO, and he shared that they designed a new device that can be integrated in running shoes to track any runner's performance and can potentially be used to improve performance. We can start working on a new shoe line with it. Let's have a meeting with them on {!whoop_meeting = this:WED+1w}.
emails.subject: WHOOP Collaboration Meeting

emails.body:
Hi Mark,
WHOOP just gave me a call and asked to reschedule our meeting to earlier on Wednesday morning, now we start at 9:00am.
emails.subject: WHOOP Meeting Reschedule

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Guys from R&D and I are planning to visit WHOOP's HQ in Boston to advise on the fabrication process. We'd love you to join. We'll decide on dates during our ad-hoc strategy meeting on {!strategy_meeting = this:MON+1w}. If you have any other companies we can pay a visit to on your mind, please let me know till then.

ops.create: Ad-hoc Strategy Meeting for Boston Trip

emails.subject: Boston Partnership Trip

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

I think we can go talk to Boston Dynamics folks about testing our products. Humanoid robots seem to be a good prospect for improving our manufacturing process. I'll shoot an email to their CSO.
emails.subject: Boston Dynamics Visit in Boston

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We finalized dates to for the trip to be from {!boston_trip_start = week_of:(dom:6,+1m)} till {!boston_trip_end = dom:9,+1m}. We will visit WHOOP on the first day, and Boston Dynamics on the third one. I'll notify you if other tech companies respond.
emails.subject: Boston Trip Details

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We'll also visit Actnano, Inc. They seem to be doing cool stuff with nano-coating, and we can work with them to develop new water- and water-repelling and dirt-resistant technology for our shoes. We'll go to them right the day we're leaving.
emails.subject: New Meeting during Boston Trip

emails.body:
Hello Mark,

We received an invitation to attend and present during Footwear Biomechanics Symposium in Oslo on {!fbs_conference = dom:25,+2m} . They would like us to tell more about our recently released line of shoes with degradable technology. Let's have a meeting on {!fbs_planning_meeting = this:FRI} to gather a delegation. Please talk to CTO about best candidates before then.

ops.create: Talk to CTO about team for FBS

emails.subject: FBS Invitation

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Got your email about FBS. I'm sure we'll need to invite some guys from SpadXTech, since they were our primary partners developing this line. I've scheduled a meeting with them on the second day of our Boston trip, since we'll be nearby.
emails.subject: SpadXTech Meeting before FBS

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

For some reason, Boston Dynamics had to cancel our visit. I'll be figuring out if we can reschedule it before we leave.
emails.subject: Boston Dynamics Cancel

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Just letting you know - SpadXTech confirmed that they can send a couple of guys from their team with us. We'll still visit their office to discuss some details.
emails.subject: SpadXTech confirmed FBS attendance
